page.layout: One page, without text. Red staff lines run down the whole page, with black square notes and diamond-shaped neumes on them. Large decorated initials stand between the staves. A paper library label sits at the upper left.
page.notes: No printed running text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. The staff lines, neumes and large decorated initials are music notation and ornament, not readable words, so nothing is transcribed from them. The paper label reading "Phaed. Th. 75" is a library shelf mark and is left out. The staves and neumes suggest a leaf from a manuscript or early printed choir book. Some of the large letters are only partly recognisable, but none is legible as a word.
